headline: Sensex tanks 989 points as Nifty falls below 25,650 driven by rising crude oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex plummeted 989 points and Nifty slipped below 25,650 as Brent crude breached $97 per barrel.
Heavy selling was seen in Auto and IT sectors, with both indices declining over 1% each.
Shriram Finance and Bajaj Auto led the major losses in the headline benchmark indices.
The rupee rally hit a bump as global market developments and AI trade dynamics impacted sentiment.
whatHappening: Britannia Industries CMO Puneet Das resigned from his post within 10 months of joining.
Nestle India received an EPFO demand of ₹36.36 lakh, which includes a ₹20 lakh penalty.
SEBI is examining the deal between Tata Steel and APL Apollo with a focus on minority interest.
Union Cabinet approved a fresh women's quota bill linked to the delimitation process.
summary: Indian benchmark indices slumped sharply today with Sensex dropping 989 points to close weak as Brent crude crossed $97. Shriram Finance and Bajaj Auto led the market sell-off while the metal sector bucked the trend. Key company updates included executive exit at Britannia and regulatory updates on Nestle India and Tata Steel.
